News global nation business lifestyle entertainment technology sports opinion LATEST NEWS STORIES HEADLINES METRO REGIONS NATION WORLD CDN NEWSLETTER www / Philippine Elections Philippine Elections Comelec assures clean, honest 2028 elections amid cheating concerns By: Dianne Sampang - @inquirerdotnet INQUIRER.net / 02:47 PM November 28, 2026 Share: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Elections (Comelec) on Saturday said clean and honest 2028 elections will be achieved through transparency, openness, and strict compliance with the 1987 Constitution.
This was the response of Comelec chair George Erwin Garcia when asked how the poll body will ensure that the 2028 national and local elections will be free from fraud and cheating.
“Transparency, openness and strict observance of the mandate of the Constitution and the rule of law. These are the basic foundation of a credible and honest elections,” Garcia told the INQUIRER in a Viber message.
READ: Sara Duterte to form legal, IT teams to guard against 2028 poll cheating
This came after Vice President Sara Duterte on Friday said that her camp is already preparing for her legal and IT (information technology) teams for possible cheating occurrences in the 2028 elections. Duterte announced her presidential bid for the much-anticipated elections as early as February this year.
During her press conference, Duterte said that while their network on the ground is not yet activated, her camp has prepared the legal and IT teams “because this will be a fight against cheating in the elections.” She also shared that some election lawyers already committed to join her legal team.
Garcia then expressed support in the fight against cheating and fraud in the elections.
“Kasama po kami ng Pangalawang Pangulo sa paglaban sa lahat ng uri ng pandaraya sa halalan lalong lalo na ang pamimili ng boto, walang pakundangan na paggamit ng pondo at kagamitan ng pamahalaan para sa pansariling kapakanan at malawakang pagkakalat ng mga maling kaalaman,” Garcia added.
(We are with the vice president in the fight against any forms of cheating in the elections, particularly in vote-selling, abuse of state resources, and dissemination of wrong information.)
Garcia also maintained that there will be elections in 2028 after Duterte said that two lawmakers from the House of Representatives were allegedly plotting a plan for charter change, or the amendment of the 1987 Constitution, although she did not name them. Duterte noted that the “no el” can only happen through the amendment of the Constitution.
READ: Comelec: ‘No election’ via Constitutional amendment not possible
Garcia repeatedly dismissed claims that there will be no elections in that year as he stressed that the 1987 Constitution mandates the conduct of elections in 2028.
Last June, Garcia also said that a “no el” scenario in 2028 through an amendment of the Constitution is not possible due to the lack of rules allowing it. He noted that the rule to amend the Constitution is suspended.
In January 2024, the Comelec suspended any proceedings regarding people’s initiative to amend the 1987 Constitution. The Comelec Resolution No. 10650, promulgated in January 2020, served as the implementing rules and regulations of Republic Act No. 6735, or the Initiative and Referendum Act.
